text:
Jenna L.: Quick Q — had to add two personal nights after a work trip. Company paid for the original 3 nights on the corporate card, but the extension was on my personal card. Hotel gave me one folio covering all nights. How do I split the company nights for reimbursement and per‑diem? cc @Maria G.

Maria G. (People Ops): Short answer: we reimburse only the company nights and travel days. We need either (A) an itemized folio that shows nightly charges separated by date, or (B) the hotel reissue an invoice that splits the company portion from the personal portion. If neither is possible, we can accept the full folio + the corporate card txn + a short written statement from the hotel (email from billing) that confirms which nights were charged to the company card.

Maria G. (People Ops): Per‑diem: we only allow per‑diem for approved travel days. Nights that are personal extensions are not eligible. For partial travel days (first/last), use the partial per‑diem rate in the KB (usually 75% for travel day, but check the country table).

Jenna L.: OK — hotel said billing can email an itemized folio but may take 48h. If I submit before that, should I create a placeholder expense?

Maria G. (People Ops): Yes — submit the company portion now with a placeholder attachment and tag it "pending folio." In Ramp put a short note: "awaiting itemized folio from hotel (sent to employee by billing)" and attach the card charge screenshot. Once you have the itemized folio, upload it and add a comment in the expense. Finance will hold final approval until we receive the folio, but starting the submission helps keep timelines short.

Maria G. (People Ops): If the corporate card failed for the covered nights (so you used personal card for both company & personal nights), we can either: 1) have Finance reimburse the company-eligible nights after you provide proof and a billing note from hotel; or 2) issue a retro travel advance/one-time card replacement if that helps in future trips. Ping finance@redwood for advance requests.

Maria G. (People Ops): Quick Ramp checklist (paste into the expense comment if helpful):
``
- Expense type: Lodging
- Amount: $XXX (company nights only)
- Attach: corp card txn screenshot + itemized folio OR folio + hotel billing email
- Tags: trip:<team>-<city>, project:<if applicable>
- Note: "Company nights 2025-07-10 to 2025-07-13; personal extension 2025-07-13 to 2025-07-15"
```

Samir R.: FYI I hit this last month in Amsterdam — billing reissued an itemized folio after I emailed the billing manager. Took a day. If hotel is reluctant, ask for an invoice that shows dates and last 4 of the card used. That made finance happy.

Alex K.: Also, for foreign currency -> Ramp auto-converts but if your card charged a different amount due to FX fees, include your bank statement line or the card txn details. Helps avoid mismatches.

Jenna L.: Great, thanks. One last: per‑diem on partial days — is there a place in KB with the exact % by region?

people-ops-bot: KB: Travel per‑diem & partial day rates — https://redwood.kb/travel/per-diem (includes country table and examples). :link:

Maria G. (People Ops): Yep — that KB page has the table and examples. If anything unclear after billing folio arrives, DM me and I can review before you hit submit. :thumbsup:

Samir R.: Pro tip — ask billing to CC the hotel invoice to your work email so we have the hotel-sent proof in case the personal email gets buried.

Jenna L.: Will do, thanks everyone!
